name: slide_write
description: Write one slide into the deck as its generator builds slides (lift-up FUNC-1), from a slide in the JSON Narrato writes (`deck_generate`'s `slides`): its layout chosen for its items, each place filled, its figures, builds, and icons, in the deck's theme and the brief it keeps. After the slide that holds `after`, in place of the slide that holds `replace` (its beat kept, its picture shown again, the nodes no other slide shows taken away with it), or at the end. Its states join `beat`, a beat of the spine whose claim it tells (plan the spine with `spine_update` first), which keeps what it says; with none, it gets a beat of its own, and a deck with no spine yet begins one, the slide taking the place of `deck_create`'s blank slide. Its set of texts held to one size and lint's fixes taken, as a made deck's are; what no fix mends is in `left`, a text past its place first. One patch, refused as `deck_patch` refuses one, reported as `deck_patch` reports one, with the slide's states, layout, and beat.

bundle.description: The bundle: a directory, a `.scaena` zip, or a `deck.json`.

slide.description:
One slide, as Narrato writes each of `deck_generate`'s `slides`: `slideTitle`, `subtitle`,
`layoutSuggestion`, `keyBullets`, `speakerNotes`, and `chartData`, `icons`, `beatName`,
`purpose`, `intent`, `expectedIntensity`, and `expectedValence` where it has them.

after.description: The slide goes after the slide that holds this state.

replace.description:
The slide is written in place of the slide that holds this state, with all its steps, in
its beat. Without it or `after`, the slide goes after every slide.

beat.description:
The id of a beat of the spine whose claim this slide tells, as `spine_update` planned it:
the slide's states join it, and it keeps what it says, the slide giving only what it lacks
(its notes, Narrato's fields). Without it, the slide gets a beat of its own after the slide
before it, and a deck with no spine yet begins one. Not with `replace`, which keeps the
beat of the slide it takes the place of.

dry_run.description: Say what would change, and write nothing.

oneOf.description:
Put `value` at `path`: a member of an object (one already there is replaced, in its
place), or an item of an array, at an index or at its end (`-`).
Replace what is at `path`, which must be there.

`remove` at `from`, then `add` at `path`. A member moved within its object keeps its
place: a rename.
Fail the patch unless `path` holds `value` (numbers equal by value: 1 is 1.0).

Pointer.description:
A JSON Pointer (RFC 6901): empty, the whole document, or `/`-separated tokens, `~1` for a
`/` and `~0` for a `~` inside one.

Finding.description: One lint finding, shaped for agents: a code, a JSON pointer, and (when safe) a fix.

file.description: The bundle file `path` points into, when it is not `deck.json` (a theme file).

format.description: The format the deck was laid out in (`"9:16"`), when it is not the deck's own.

fix.description: A JSON Patch (RFC 6902) that resolves the finding. Only safe, non-content fixes.

refresh.description:
The data source to fetch again, where what resolves the finding is a fetch, which no patch
makes (W428, ADR-0030): the source's name, without its `@`.

applied.description: Whether the deck was written: not under a dry run, nor when the patch was refused.

patch.description: The patch as RFC 6902, in order.

added.description: What `validate` and `lint` find after the patch that they did not before.

removed.description: What they found before that they do not after.

errors.description: The findings that are errors, after.

states.description:
The states it changes, by id: each whose nodes, resolved with the deck's overrides,
or whose layout, transition, choreography, hold, notes, or slide number and footer are
not as they were, and each it adds. None when it is refused.
